name: Editorial Offering Memorandum (v2)
about: Our own editorial OM design: airy, left-aligned, one focal point per slide. Slots are defined once and placed on slides by id; each slide names its layout (drawn in services/om_design.py). Legal wording is placeholder text in config/om_legal_placeholder.json.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.description: What is for sale, and why it deserves a close look.

sections.title: Property Overview
sections.description: The buildings, the site and how the space is used today.

sections.title: Market Overview
sections.description: Where the property sits and what drives demand around it.

sections.title: Financial Analysis
sections.description: The asking price, the in-place income and the projected cash flow.

sections.title: Tenant Summary
sections.description: Who occupies the property, on what terms and for how long.

cover.title.label: Cover title
cover.title.why: Fixed wording on every OM cover (config/om_legal_placeholder.json).

property.name.label: Property name
property.name.why: The name buyers will know the property by, on the cover and in every footer.
property.name.broker_question: What name should the OM use for the property?
property.name.client_question: Could you confirm the exact property name you would like us to market it under?

property.address.label: Street address
property.address.why: Buyers need the exact address on the cover and the features table.
property.address.broker_question: What is the property's street address?
property.address.client_question: Could you confirm the full street address of the property, including the suite or building numbers if there are several?

property.city_state.label: City and state
property.city_state.why: Used on the cover and in the footer of every slide ("Property | City, ST").
property.city_state.broker_question: Which city and state is the property in? (for example: Fort Worth, TX)
property.city_state.client_question: Could you confirm the city and state the property is in?

photo.hero.label: Cover photo
photo.hero.why: The first thing a buyer sees. A clear exterior or aerial shot of the whole property.
photo.hero.broker_question: Please upload one strong exterior or aerial photo for the cover.
photo.hero.client_question: Do you have a recent high-quality exterior or aerial photo of the property we may use on the cover?

disclosures.text.label: Confidentiality and disclaimer (placeholder)
disclosures.text.why: Fixed placeholder legal wording from config/om_legal_placeholder.json; it must be replaced with approved legal text before any client use.

photo.divider_exec.label: Executive Summary divider photo
photo.divider_exec.why: Optional. A plain green divider is used without it.
photo.divider_exec.broker_question: Optional: a photo for the Executive Summary divider page.

offering.narrative.label: The Offering
offering.narrative.why: A short summary of what is for sale and why it is attractive, written from this deal's data.
offering.narrative.broker_question: Write two or three sentences on what is being offered, or let the AI draft it from the deal's data.

photo.offering.label: Offering photos
photo.offering.why: Two photos next to The Offering text.
photo.offering.broker_question: Please upload two exterior or interior photos for The Offering page.
photo.offering.client_question: Could you share a few recent exterior and interior photos of the property?

highlights.upside.label: Highlights: immediate upside
highlights.upside.why: Why a buyer could add value quickly (for example leases rolling to market).
highlights.upside.broker_question: List two or three reasons a buyer could add value soon, or let the AI draft them.

highlights.location_building.label: Highlights: location and building
highlights.location_building.why: What is good about the site and the building.
highlights.location_building.broker_question: List two or three location or building features, or let the AI draft them.

highlights.rare.label: Highlights: rare opportunity
highlights.rare.why: What makes this offering hard to find.
highlights.rare.broker_question: List one to three things that make this offering unusual, or let the AI draft them.

photo.highlights_aerial.label: Highlights aerial
photo.highlights_aerial.why: An aerial next to the highlights. The AI cannot make aerials: they need licensed imagery.
photo.highlights_aerial.broker_question: Please upload an aerial photo of the property.
photo.highlights_aerial.client_question: Do you have a recent aerial photo of the property we may use? If not, we can arrange one.

photo.divider_property.label: Property Overview divider photo
photo.divider_property.why: Optional. A plain green divider is used without it.
photo.divider_property.broker_question: Optional: a photo for the Property Overview divider page.

property.type.label: Property type
property.type.broker_question: What type of property is it (Industrial, Flex, Retail, ...)?

property.buildings.label: Number of buildings
property.buildings.why: Buyers compare single- and multi-building sites differently.
property.buildings.broker_question: How many buildings are on the site?
property.buildings.client_question: How many separate buildings are on the property?

property.total_sf.label: Total SF
property.total_sf.why: The building size every per-SF figure is based on.

property.avg_unit_size.label: Average unit size
property.avg_unit_size.why: Tells buyers the typical tenant size.

property.bay_doors.label: Bay doors
property.bay_doors.why: Optional. Industrial buyers look for dock-high and drive-in doors. Left off the slide if unknown.
property.bay_doors.broker_question: How many dock-high and drive-in doors are there? (for example: 24 dock-high, 6 drive-in)
property.bay_doors.client_question: Could you tell us how many dock-high and drive-in doors the buildings have?

property.clear_height.label: Clear height
property.clear_height.why: Optional. Matters for warehouse use. Left off the slide if unknown.
property.clear_height.broker_question: What is the clear height? (for example: 24')
property.clear_height.client_question: Do you know the clear height inside the buildings?

property.land_size.label: Land size
property.land_size.why: Buyers value land and parking; it is a standard line in the features table.
property.land_size.client_question: Could you confirm the size of the land parcel, in acres if you have it?

property.year_built.label: Year built / renovated
property.year_built.why: Age and renovations drive a buyer's capital plan.
property.year_built.broker_question: What year was it built, and any year of major renovation? (for example: 1998 / 2019)
property.year_built.client_question: What year was the property built, and has it had any major renovations (roof, HVAC, parking) since?

property.leased_pct.label: Current occupancy (% leased)
property.leased_pct.why: Leased SF as a share of total SF, from the rent roll.

photo.features.label: Features photo
photo.features.why: A photo beside the features table.
photo.features.broker_question: Please upload one more exterior or interior photo for the features page.
photo.features.client_question: Could you share a few recent exterior and interior photos of the property?

photo.site_plan.label: Site plan
photo.site_plan.why: Shows the buildings, parking and access. The AI cannot draw site plans: please upload one.
photo.site_plan.broker_question: Please upload a site plan (or an aerial with the site outlined).
photo.site_plan.client_question: Do you have a site plan or survey of the property you could share?

site_plan.notes.label: Site plan notes
site_plan.notes.why: Optional: a short legend beside the site plan (access points, parking, buildings).
site_plan.notes.broker_question: Anything to point out on the site plan? One note per line (optional).

photo.grid.label: Photo page
photo.grid.why: A page of 1 to 4 photos; the layout adapts to how many there are and their shapes.
photo.grid.broker_question: Please upload four exterior or interior photos.
photo.grid.client_question: Could you share a few recent exterior and interior photos of the property?

photo.divider_market.label: Market Overview divider photo
photo.divider_market.why: Optional. A plain green divider is used without it.
photo.divider_market.broker_question: Optional: a photo for the Market Overview divider page.

location.narrative.label: Location overview
location.narrative.why: Where the property sits and what drives demand there, from cited research and the broker.
location.narrative.broker_question: Describe the location in two or three sentences (access, nearby demand drivers), or run research and let the AI draft it.

photo.location_aerial.label: Location aerial
photo.location_aerial.why: Shows the property in its surroundings. The AI cannot make maps: they need licensed imagery.
photo.location_aerial.broker_question: Please upload an aerial or map showing the property and nearby roads.
photo.location_aerial.client_question: Do you have an aerial or location map of the property and the roads around it?

photo.regional_aerial.label: Regional aerial
photo.regional_aerial.why: Optional. A wider view of the region.
photo.regional_aerial.broker_question: Optional: a regional aerial or map.

photo.divider_financial.label: Financial Analysis divider photo
photo.divider_financial.why: Optional. A plain green divider is used without it.
photo.divider_financial.broker_question: Optional: a photo for the Financial Analysis divider page.

financial.sale_price.label: Sale price
financial.sale_price.why: The asking price. Only the broker sets it; the AI never does. Price per SF and cap rates are calculated from it.
financial.sale_price.broker_question: What is the asking price? (only you set this; a BOV value, if any, is shown as a suggestion)

financial.price_per_sf.label: Price per SF
financial.price_per_sf.why: Sale price divided by total SF.

financial.cap_rate_y4.label: Year-4 cap rate
financial.cap_rate_y4.why: Projected year-4 NOI divided by the sale price, from approved assumptions.

photo.financial.label: Pricing page photo
photo.financial.why: Optional photo beside the price tiles.
photo.financial.broker_question: Optional: a photo for the pricing page.

financial.cash_flow.label: Cash flow projections
financial.cash_flow.why: In-place plus five years, calculated from the T-12, the rent roll and approved assumptions only.

financial.assumptions_note.label: Leasing assumptions note
financial.assumptions_note.why: Lists the approved assumptions so the projections can be explained.

photo.divider_tenant.label: Tenant Summary divider photo
photo.divider_tenant.why: Optional. A plain green divider is used without it.
photo.divider_tenant.broker_question: Optional: a photo for the Tenant Summary divider page.

tenant.rent_roll.label: Tenant rent roll
tenant.rent_roll.why: Every unit, tenant, size, lease dates and rent, from the rent roll.

contacts.list.label: Investment contacts
contacts.list.why: Who buyers call. Taken from your profile (name, title, phone, email).
contacts.list.broker_question: Please complete your profile in Settings (title and phone).

backcover.text.label: Back cover notice
backcover.text.why: Fixed placeholder wording. Edit only in config/om_legal_placeholder.json.
